translation: Flavor salty, slightly cold, slightly cold. It expels evil-qi (邪氣), evil wind (惡風), sweating (汗出), removes heat bindings in the skin (皮中熱結), accumulations and gu-poison (積聚蠱毒), and white worms and tapeworms coming out unceasingly by themselves (白蟲、寸白自出不止). Taken for a long time it makes one impotent (陰痿).
